assumptions: Printed order = csl-orig record order; alias records ({{Lbody=N}}) are digitiser additions and are excluded from every view but `all`.
Sort key = k1 (accentless normalised SLP1); k2 accents and hyphens are not a sort level.
Consecutive records with the same k1 are one position (unit).
A descent is an alphabet restart (segment boundary, e.g. a supplement) when the next 10 units all sort below the previous 10; restarts are reported as segments, not counted as violations.
A policy contrast needs >= 30 disagreeing adjacent pairs; fewer = undetermined.
AP's collation is scored on its `heads` view (paragraph run-ons and root-nest derivatives removed); its `main` view is reported alongside.
Running heads are not in the csl-orig data; they are out of scope for this census.
